about_the_game:
Nomads Descent: Last Stand is a roguelike exploration and survival game where you delve into procedurally generated dungeons filled with enemies, traps, and secrets. Choose from a variety of classes with unique abilities and customize your character with each new journey. Find rare treasures, upgrade your arsenal, and face challenges that demand tactical adaptation. Every new run offers a unique and challenging experience.

Infinite Replayability

The game features multiple playable classes, each with unique abilities. With every new run, you can choose a class and customize your skills, creating different strategies for each journey. The variety of options ensures a constantly fresh and engaging gameplay experience.

Endless Exploration

Exploration is full of challenges and rewards. Dungeons packed with diverse enemies and traps require constant adaptation, while secret passages and hidden treasures offer valuable surprises. Discover rare artifacts and unlock new powers as you navigate dangerous environments, where every secret you find can change the course of your journey.

Challenges Await You

In the dungeons, you will face a wide variety of enemies and traps, testing your combat and strategic skills. Each environment offers new obstacles that require tactical adaptation, creating a unique and challenge-filled experience with every exploration.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Celeron Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics or Better
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core I3 or Better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelike where every choice can determine your survival. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, choose from unique classes, and adapt to unpredictable challenges with strategic abilities and modifiers that transform each run.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Russian, Thai
